name: Scuff the Tabby-and-White Cat
blurb: Scuff, a sturdy brown tabby with a white nose stripe, white chest and four white paws, zooms down the sloping garden path and slides to a halt.

name: Thistle the White-Socked Cat
blurb: Thistle, a dark-striped brown tabby with a snowy bib, white socks and pale green eyes, walks the garden wall and leans down to peer right at you.

name: Cobble the Snow-Bib Cat
blurb: Cobble, a brown-and-black striped tabby with a white bib, white paws and a white muzzle, hops each garden step in one bound without a sound.
